selection.rationale: All four approved County pages principally describe named storm-drain or flood-reduction projects. No unrelated backlog record is included.

source_verification.live_check_2026_09_29: County site returned HTTP 403 to direct requests and web retrieval; no fresh HTTP 200 claim is made.
source_verification.archive_decision: These are maintained official HTML project pages with no static original selected for publication; no R2 object is invented or uploaded.

family_review.finding: Phase 1 completed in August 2018. The later source is titled Phase 2B/3, says Phase 2A is complete, and includes an August 26, 2026 construction update. The existing Phase 2A entry stays separate and unchanged.

Hooper is a completed 2018 road-drainage project. Garduño/Ortega is a separate 4th Street pump-station, Garduño Road storm-drain, and Pond 5 design record; its 2020 construction schedule is historical, not proof of completion.

placement_review.heading_change: Rename Historical County Drainage Projects to cover the active Barcelona 2B/3 source while retaining historical entries.
placement_review.cross_listing: No new Roadway Projects cross-listing. The existing Phase 2A roadway entry stays unchanged; drainage is the primary subject of these four sources.

entries.title: Barcelona Road Storm Drain Project Phase 1
entries.quality_finding: Useful as a linked component of the curated County drainage group: the source identifies built drainage and roadway elements, named drains, funding, and August 2018 completion.
entries.description: The County's first Barcelona Road phase connected new runoff collection to the Armijo Drain and added bicycle lanes, curb and gutter, and a sidewalk near Barcelona Elementary. The project page reports construction completed in August 2018.

entries.title: Barcelona Road Storm Drain Project Phase 2B/3
entries.quality_finding: Substantive live project update with a distinct later Barcelona segment and named roads. The page's design, bidding, and construction fields conflict in timing; cite its dated August 2026 construction notice rather than assert final completion.
entries.description: The County's Phase 2B/3 plan extends storm-drain and roadway work from Barcelona Circle West toward the Isleta Drain and nearby streets. Its August 26, 2026 update reports storm-drain and road work starting on Yuma south of Barcelona; the page also retains design and later construction estimates, so completion is unconfirmed.

entries.title: Hooper Road SW Drainage Improvements
entries.quality_finding: Short but distinct completed drainage work; present as one component of the County drainage group, not a standalone document.
entries.description: The County built about 300 feet of storm drain on Hooper Road SW with state capital-improvement funding. Its project page records completion in May 2018.

entries.title: Garduño/Ortega Storm Drain Developments
entries.quality_finding: Substantive distinct drainage design with a pump-station replacement, new drain, and Pond 5 storage proposal. The source's old anticipated schedule does not establish construction or completion.
entries.description: The County's design record proposes replacing the 4th Street and Ortega Road pump station and force main, adding a Garduño Road storm drain to Paseo del Norte Pond 5, and modestly increasing pond storage. The page labels the project as design; its older construction schedule is not a completion report.
